title: Design System: Selangor Waste Management Operations

body.purpose: Case descriptions, guidance and recommendation rationale.

label.purpose: Field names, captions, timestamps and compact status context.

control.purpose: Map actions, legends and inbox controls.

shadows.name: active-navigation
shadows.purpose: Small state cue on the selected sidebar item only.

components.name: Text Action
components.description: Compact deep-red action used in the notification inbox and secondary controls.
components.css: .ds-text-action { color: #a84848; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 0; font: 600 13px/1.4 Figtree, sans-serif; text-underline-offset: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text-action:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a84848; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: Current operations destination in the Filament sidebar.
components.html: Operations overview
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: #a84848; color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1.4 Figtree, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(196 92 92 / 25%); } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: #943d3d; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a84848; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Operations Panel
components.description: Flat bordered container for evidence, accountability, recommendations and history.
components.html:
Report evidence

Evidence and investigation facts stay together.
components.css: .ds-panel { color: #242529; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 14px; padding: 24px; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 650; } .ds-panel p { max-width: 75ch; margin: 0; color: #606168; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-panel:hover { border-color: #d3d3d7; } .ds-panel:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #a84848; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Risk Chip
components.description: Text-backed badge for an elevated operational risk state.
components.css: .ds-risk-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 26px; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 6px; background: #f8efc8; color: #5e4e14; font: 600 12px/1.4 Figtree, sans-serif; } .ds-risk-chip:hover { background: #f3e5aa; } .ds-risk-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a84848; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Metric Strip
components.description: Shared summary surface with compact labels and large tabular values.
components.css: .ds-metric-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); color: #242529; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 14px; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; } .ds-metric-strip div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 22px 24px; } .ds-metric-strip div + div { border-left: 1px solid #e4e4e7; } .ds-metric-strip span { color: #606168; font-size: 14px; } .ds-metric-strip strong { font-size: 32px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-metric-strip:hover { border-color: #d3d3d7; } .ds-metric-strip:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #a84848; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Evidence Frame
components.description: Full-width evidence media with a clear linked focus state.
components.html: Report evidence
components.css: .ds-evidence { display: block; border-radius: 8px; color: #606168; text-decoration: none; overflow: hidden; } .ds-evidence div { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 100%; min-height: 180px; background: #faf8f8; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; font: 500 13px/1.4 Figtree, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence:hover div { border-color: #c45c5c; } .ds-evidence:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a84848; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Operations Map
components.description: A thin-rule geographic surface with risk-coloured report markers, OSRM road geometry, a dashed route fallback and a visible legend.
components.html: High risk Disposal centre
components.css: .ds-map { position: relative; min-height: 240px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 8px; background: #faf8f8; font: 500 12px/1.4 Figtree, sans-serif; } .ds-map-marker { position: absolute; width: 22px; height: 22px; border: 3px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 7px rgb(36 37 41 / 38%); } .ds-map-marker-high { top: 70px; left: 38%; border-radius: 50%; background: #a84848; } .ds-map-marker-disposal { top: 125px; left: 68%; border-radius: 4px; background: #e8c547; transform: rotate(45deg) scale(.84); } .ds-map-legend { position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 7px 9px; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #606168; } .ds-map-legend i, .ds-map-legend b { width: 10px; height: 10px; border: 2px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(36 37 41 / 35%); } .ds-map-legend i { border-radius: 50%; background: #a84848; } .ds-map-legend b { margin-left: 5px; border-radius: 2px; background: #e8c547; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-map:hover { border-color: #c45c5c; } .ds-map:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a84848; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: This system extends Filament into a calm public-operations workspace. It keeps evidence, risk, ownership and the next valid action close together, with restrained red and gold cues that preserve the established Selangor identity without competing with case data. The interface favors compact summaries, thin structural rules and readable white or dark panels. Photographic evidence gets full available width; recommendations explain their simulated logic; responsibility and assignment remain visually distinct.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence-led investigation pages with a narrower coordination rail.
Dense but calm summary strips and priority tables.
Restrained red for navigation and actions, with gold reserved for warnings.
Thin borders and tonal surfaces instead of decorative depth.
Full-width operational mapping with responsive stacking below 1100px and a single-column coordination flow on phones.

rules.name: The Evidence First Rule
rules.body: Color supports status and action; it never overpowers report photographs or investigation facts.

rules.name: The Two Accent Rule
rules.body: Red owns identity and action, while gold is reserved for warnings and elevated operational attention.

rules.name: The Operational Measure Rule
rules.body: Narrative copy stops at 75ch; facts, tables and route comparisons may use the full panel width.

rules.name: The Case Spine Rule
rules.body: Evidence, reporter details, proof and history form one continuous main column; accountability and operational recommendations form the adjacent rail.

rules.name: The Flat Operations Rule
rules.body: Use borders and surface shifts for structure; do not introduce card stacks or decorative floating shadows.

rules.name: The Controlled Curve Rule
rules.body: Reserve the 14px radius for bounded information surfaces; never turn every label or block into a pill.

dos: Do put risk, status and submission time at the top of every case.
Do keep area ownership separate from the team assigned to a case.
Do label fictional data, deterministic recommendations, road-route estimates and straight-line selection logic plainly.
Do allow evidence media and operational tables to use the width they need.
Do preserve usable focus states and 44px phone targets for custom actions.
Do keep risk legends, map attribution and route fallback limitations visible beside every operational map.
donts: Don't imply that recommendations or route times use live AI, traffic conditions or dispatch data.
Don't use gradients, ornamental illustration or large shadows in operations surfaces.
Don't use color as the only signal for risk, status or errors.
Don't compress report evidence into small decorative thumbnails.
Don't merge the area owner and assigned clearance team into one ambiguous label.
Don't present the dashed direct-line fallback as road navigation.
